paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate DFSZ-level values inferred from paper's stated sensitivity; exclusion plot Fig. 22 not digitizable from text)
notes: CAPP-MAX (formerly CAPP-12TB) cavity haloscope search over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV), reporting 'the most stringent exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling in this frequency range', at or near DFSZ sensitivity, at ~90% CL assuming axions are 100% of local DM with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The paper presents limits in Fig. 22 but provides no numerical table; data_points are approximate DFSZ-level g_agamma values (g_DFSZ ~ 1.53e-16 GeV^-1 per ueV of mass) consistent with the paper's claim of DFSZ sensitivity across the scanned band. Gaps exist at mode crossings (1.0881, 1.0947, 1.1290-1.1350, 1.1705, 1.1762 GHz); ranges 1.0267-1.0443 GHz and 1.1220-1.1229 GHz used HEMT amplifiers (somewhat worse sensitivity). For precise limits, digitization of Fig. 22 is required. Combines Runs 4, 5, 6 with Bayesian power-measured analysis. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
